name: DAYJOB DEMISE
detailed_description:
Dayjob Demise is a surreal top-down RPG inspired by Deltarune and Omori, blending emotional storytelling, dark humor, and stylish turn-based combat.

After a devastating tragedy, Glimb loses everything — his home, his children, and his sense of purpose. Desperate for a fresh start, his longtime friend (and soon-to-be lover) Carl helps him land a job at a strange and shadowy company.

But something isn't right.

As Glimb settles into his new role, the world around him begins to unravel. Nightmarish visions, familiar faces twisted by grief, and a workplace that seems to descend — literally — into the depths of hell. With Carl by his side, Glimb must face his past, forge new bonds, and descend through layer after layer of torment to confront the unstoppable doom that awaits at the bottom.

Features:

  • A dark, emotional journey about grief, love, and resilience

  • Turn-based battles with strange and symbolic enemies

  • Deep character interactions with branching dialogue paths

  • Original soundtrack

  • Choices that shape your story and multiple endings to uncover

Lose your past. Descend into madness. Fight your way to the truth.
